$comment: Phase -> capability mapping. 'workspace' entries live in the target repo's .claude/ and are CALLED, never copied. 'plugin' entries ship here because they do not exist in the workspace. A phase whose required skills are all missing degrades to its fallback and says so out loud.

intake.fallback: Classify from the ticket text alone and state the classification.

audit.fallback: Grep-only reuse scan; record reduced confidence in the ADR.
audit.$toolNote: ast-grep evaluated and deferred: it returns zero matches, silently, for any path argument containing [ or ] — which this repo's route directories use throughout. Revisit if that is fixed upstream.

brainstorm.fallback: Present 2-4 approaches with tradeoffs against the CLAUDE.md priority order before choosing.

adr.fallback: Follow the structure of the most recent file in docs/adr/.

plan.fallback: One plan file per stacked PR with goal, changes, acceptance criteria.

branch.fallback: Feature branch off develop; never commit to a protected branch.

implement_ui.fallback: Verify every Teserra export via the Storybook MCP before importing it.

implement_logic.fallback: Follow the two most recently merged comparable features.

i18n.fallback: Audit every user-facing string, JSX children and props alike.

telemetry.fallback: Follow the event naming convention already used in the module.

test_unit.fallback: RTL with accessible queries; behaviour not implementation.

test_stories.fallback: One story per meaningful state, including loading, empty and error.

test_e2e.fallback: Cover all ten branches named in CLAUDE.md Testing.

a11y.fallback: WCAG 2.2 AA: keyboard, contrast, focus, semantics.

verify_browser.fallback: Cypress run only; record that live browser verification was skipped.

ship.fallback: gh stack submit; never gh pr merge.

learn.fallback: Record review feedback verbatim; do not attempt to route it.

review_round.$note: Not a linear phase: a round happens each time review lands, and may repeat.
review_round.fallback: Harvest the PR, triage with the human, fix on the PR's own branch, reply to every thread.

adr.$note: Bug track writes a fix-approach note, not a full ADR, unless the fix is architectural.
